name: understand-this-video
display_name: Understand This Video For Me AI Plugin
description: Let your AI watch and hear a video: key frames, transcript and contact sheet, processed locally.
long_description: Give your AI a local video file or a YouTube/Vimeo/Loom link. It gets timestamped key frames, a transcript (site captions, or local Whisper when installed) and a contact-sheet image. Requires ffmpeg and a $49 lifetime licence.

tools.name: understand_this_video
tools.description: Watch and hear a video file or link: key frames, transcript, contact sheet.
